Pickleball workout copy covers paddle-court sessions, pickleball court session summaries, heart rate during pickleball, active calories, and duration cards — 匹克球 / 匹克球训练 / 匹克球卡路里 / 匹克球时长. Pickleball workout copy covers paddle-court pickleball session metrics. Volleyball copy covers court team session cards — 排球 / 排球训练. Kickboxing copy covers combat-cardio session cards — 踢拳 / 踢拳训练.
